title: Agerola Font
author: RantauType
description:
Agerola – vintage retro font typeface. Agerola is  a beautiful upper and lower modern or nostalgic serif  – with a complementary italic version. I’ve also love combination the reguler and italic make cool and nostalgic. Agerola included alternate, ligature and multilingual characters
Agerola – perfectly suitable for creating elegant, chic, lifestyle design such as logos, title, and magazine, and more. Now you have more choice when using Agerola for typography. Agerola here to make your work to high level!!!
Features:
Standar character A-Z and a-z
Numberial and Functional
Alternate
Ligature
International Multilinggual Support
File include:
Agerola (reguler and italic) OTF
Agerola (reguler and italic) TTF
